title: Earnings Reactions Hit Resistance: Key Levels Revealed
speaker: Drew Dosk

macro_themes.view: Tech earnings this week (SpaceX, Netflix, Tesla, Meta) are the near-term driver against an unpretty macro backdrop.
Doubts the Pakistan-brokered peace headlines; 24+ tankers struck in Hormuz last week and conflict likely to escalate after the midterms.

calls.reason: Failed bull flag followed by sideways consolidation hugging the rising support trend line; as long as it stays this way a break lower is more likely.
calls.quote: as long as we keep remaining This way, a break is more likely with the next test down here at 76040.

calls.condition: Bulls need a close above 26,579 to open near-term upside
calls.reason: Nasdaq closed below the declining trend line once but has had no follow-through; middle ground pending tech earnings.
calls.quote: the bulls want to see a close above 26,579 points tomorrow.

calls.reason: Sideways consolidation in a rising parallel channel into tech earnings; investors trimming before earnings.
calls.quote: the near term right now on the SMH is more sideways consolidation.

calls.reason: After a violent breakout, a topping tail/'sleeper hold' pattern says a near-term top is in; expects chop in 5.021-5.289 and likely a touch of 5.021.
calls.quote: near-term top is in likely for more downside... We were likely due to come and actually physically touch this 5.021%.

calls.reason: Bear-flag consolidation points to a break below $4,000 toward 3,900/3,800; ideal 'honeypot' zone to buy physical gold just above $3,600 (trend line and April 2025 pivot ~3,500).
calls.quote: I see more downside in gold... right there in that zone would be the ideal honeypot zone to pick up some physical gold

calls.condition: If silver breaks the near-term bull-flag low, head-and-shoulders measured move to 53.26
calls.reason: Active head-and-shoulders pattern; larger pattern bearish though near-term holding off the lows; 50-53.26 is a buy zone for physical metal.
calls.quote: We've got an active head and shoulders pattern on this chart with a targeted measured move of $53.26

calls.condition: Bullish while daily closes hold above 80,524
calls.reason: Holding above the former months-long resistance/Nov 2025 low pivot; can retest the broken H&S neckline at 89,926.
calls.quote: As long as we maintain above that, Bitcoin's got a sh a chance and a shot to go up and retest... 89,926.

calls.condition: Breakout above 103.88 targets 116; a real peace deal would send oil to 93.02 then 86.90 (he doesn't expect it)
calls.reason: Inverse head-and-shoulders with measured move to $116; peace-deal selloff recovered swiftly and Middle East conflict not simmering down.
calls.quote: What I see on the chart shows me an inverse head and shoulders pattern with a targeted measured move right up here at $116

calls.reason: Series of breakout-retrace patterns holding above the March 9 trend line; slightly below-average inventories into winter.
calls.quote: I anticipate price to break above into the $389 range.

calls.reason: Breakdown-retrace fade play from an April 2025 trend line continued through earnings; next support at channel bottom/gap fill 285.
calls.quote: it tells us likelihood of GE going down lower is actually highly probable. Next key level of support bottom of this parallel 285

calls.reason: Early breakdown-retrace fade after earnings, but rising Middle East conflict and weapons demand keep it buoyant and could break the trend line higher.
calls.quote: the demand for more products from Rathon likely will continue to press price against this inclining trend line very well may break

calls.reason: Down >50% from the top; two up days may be early dip buying - declining support trend line not yet hit, so more selling likely after near-term bounce.
calls.quote: that leads me to believe we very well could see a little bit more selling pressure on stocks like this with WDC as well as with SanDisk.

calls.condition: Needs to push up to ~1,500 to escape bearish consolidation; repeated tests of channel bottom risk a break to 1,150
calls.reason: Running into the bottom of a rising parallel channel in a bearish manner.
calls.quote: that could bring us down to the next key level of support right here around 1150 on the charts.

calls.reason: Dropping after hours on earnings around the 50% Fib retrace (May 2022 to June 2025); likely to tag the next level 61.29, with a bounce zone near 58.75.
calls.quote: Looking like we're about to go tag the next level beneath right here at $6129.

calls.condition: If SpaceX opens/closes above ~150, room to run to 160 where profit takers appear
calls.reason: 50% retrace at 140.76 defended with lower wicks; post-earnings pop could reach the rising trend line around 160.
calls.quote: you start putting in daily closes above $150 that allows SpaceX to have a little bit of room to run until that $160 mark.

notes: No explicit date spoken; dated 2026-10-20 (Tuesday) from transcript context: SpaceX and Netflix 'just reported', Tesla/Meta 'tomorrow', GE reported this morning (listing approx_date 2026-10-21). SPX support '76040' read as 7,604.0; SMH '$52,9.50' read as 529.50 and '$56425' as 564.25; WTI '$981' read as 98.10; nat gas '362'/'389' read as 3.62/3.89. NFLX ~$65 and 'SPACEX' ticker are as spoken; SpaceX symbol not stated.
